workstreams.label: Pilot evidence reconstruction
workstreams.brief: Work only on the evidence packet under /workspace/workstreams/evidence. Recompute the before/after blocker-resolution statistics, reconstruct the eight-week workflow and supported customer quote, and write /workspace/results/evidence/metrics.csv, claims_evidence.csv, and evidence_memo.md. Separate observation from causality and do not infer publication authority.

workstreams.label: Case-study editorial package

Create a polished public draft and publication checklist using only explicitly supported and approved material. Write /workspace/results/editorial/case_draft.md, case_draft.html, and publication_checklist.md.
